tests.name: cbor_tag_in_front_of_map_key_ignore
tests.intent: Verify that nlohmann::json::from_cbor successfully skips a CBOR tag in front of a map key when tag handler is ignore.

tests.name: cbor_tag_in_front_of_map_key_store
tests.intent: Verify that nlohmann::json::from_cbor successfully processes a CBOR tag in front of a map key when tag handler is store.

tests.name: cbor_tag_in_front_of_map_key_error
tests.intent: Verify that nlohmann::json::from_cbor throws parse_error when a CBOR tag is placed in front of a map key and the tag handler is error.

tests.name: cbor_indefinite_text_split_codepoint_strict
tests.intent: Verify that an indefinite-length text string with a split code point across chunks is rejected under strict UTF-8 checking.

tests.name: gen_05
tests.intent: Verify that indefinite-length text strings with error_handler_t::replace validate chunks individually and replace invalid ones per chunk.

tests.name: gen_06
tests.intent: Verify that an indefinite-length text string with error_handler_t::keep processes chunks without per-chunk validation.

tests.name: gen_07
tests.intent: Verify that parsing CBOR with an extended tag (>= 0xD8) in front of a map key using ignore tag handler successfully skips the tag and parses the map.

tests.name: gen_08
tests.intent: Verify that a malformed extended tag in front of a map key (truncated argument) returns false/throws during parsing.

tests.name: gen_09
tests.intent: Verify that a definite-length text string goes through get_cbor_string_chunk and check_string_utf8 normally.

tests.intent: Verify that nlohmann::json::from_cbor successfully skips a CBOR tag in front of a map key when tag handler is ignore.

tests.name: cbor_tag_in_front_of_map_key_store_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that nlohmann::json::from_cbor successfully processes a CBOR tag in front of a map key when tag handler is store.

tests.name: cbor_tag_in_front_of_map_key_error_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that nlohmann::json::from_cbor throws parse_error when a CBOR tag is placed in front of a map key and the tag handler is error.

tests.name: cbor_indefinite_text_split_codepoint_strict_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that an indefinite-length text string with a split code point across chunks is rejected under strict UTF-8 checking.
